ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'ProdPZEDomyslnyPTZ' and type = 'FN') drop function CDN.ProdPZEDomyslnyPTZ;

Create function CDN.ProdPZEDomyslnyPTZ(@PZEId INT) returns int as begin Declare @PTZId int = 0
SELECT @PTZId = coalesce( MAX(case when PTZ1.PTZ_KlasaCechy=PZE_KlasaCechy and PTZ1.PTZ_Cecha=PZE_Cecha and PTZ1.PTZ_EdycjaCechy=0 AND ISNULL(PTZ2.PTZ_Id,0) = 0 then PTZ1.PTZ_Id else null end ), MAX(case when PTZ1.PTZ_KlasaCechy=PZE_KlasaCechy and PTZ1.PTZ_Cecha=PZE_Cecha AND ISNULL(PTZ2.PTZ_Id,0) = 0 then PTZ1.PTZ_Id else null end), MAX(case when (PTZ1.PTZ_EdycjaCechy=1 or PTZ1.PTZ_Cecha='<Numer seryjny>') AND ISNULL(PTZ2.PTZ_Id,0) = 0 then PTZ1.PTZ_Id else null end), MAX(case when PTZ1.PTZ_KlasaCechy=PZE_KlasaCechy and PTZ1.PTZ_Cecha=PZE_Cecha and PTZ1.PTZ_EdycjaCechy=0 AND ISNULL(PTZ2.PTZ_Id,0) <> 0 then PTZ1.PTZ_Id else null end), MAX(case when PTZ1.PTZ_KlasaCechy=PZE_KlasaCechy and PTZ1.PTZ_Cecha=PZE_Cecha AND ISNULL(PTZ2.PTZ_Id,0) <> 0 then PTZ1.PTZ_Id else null end), MAX(case when (PTZ1.PTZ_EdycjaCechy=1 or PTZ1.PTZ_Cecha='<Numer seryjny>') AND ISNULL(PTZ2.PTZ_Id,0) <> 0 then PTZ1.PTZ_Id else null end)) FROM CDN.ProdZlecElem JOIN CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci PTC1 ON PTC1.PTC_Technologia = PZE_Technologia left outer join CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby PTZ1 on PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc=PTC_Id and PTZ_TwrTyp=16 and PTZ_TwrNumer=PZE_TwrNumer and PTZ_TypZasobu=0 AND CDN.Prod_WartoscAtr(PTZ1.PTZ_Ilosc,PTZ1.PTZ_IloscAtr,14340,PTC_Technologia,0,0) > 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby PTZ2 ON PTZ1.PTZ_Id = PTZ2.PTZ_TechnologiaZasob and PTC_Technologia = (SELECT PTC_Technologia FROM CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci WHERE PTC_Id = PTZ2.PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc) WHERE PZE_ID = @PZEId
return @PTZId end
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ProdPZEDomyslnyPTZ TO CDNRaport
